subject: [ANNOUNCE] New PMC member: Pavan kumar Gopidesu

messages.subject: [ANNOUNCE] New PMC member: Pavan kumar Gopidesu
messages.body:
Dear Airflow Community,

The Apache Airflow Project Management Committee (PMC) has invited Pavan
kumar Gopidesu to become a PMC member and we are excited to announce that
he has accepted our invitation.

Pavan has been a committer for the past 2 years and has made significant
contributions to the project, most notably in the CI/CD/Dev environment.
This included contributing to the Apache Software Foundation, which made
him an ASF member even before being Airflow PMC member :).

Recently Pavan has been working on the AIP-99 Common Data Access Pattern +
AI and this work is well underway.

He actively spread the Airflow word at the Airflow Summit—and spoke in
Seattle even if he could not attend the event due to visa issues. What a
dedication! Here are the talks he gave—with Amogh, Kaxil, and me.

*
https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2025/airflow-as-an-ai-agents-toolkit-unlocking-1000-integrations-with-mcp/

*
https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2025/the-secret-to-airflow-s-evergreen-build-ci-cd-magic/

The PMC is confident that he will continue to be a strong ambassador for
Airflow with his new PMC hat on.

For those unfamiliar, PMC members help manage and guide the overall
direction of the project.

Please join us in congratulating Pavan - welcome aboard!

Best regards,

Jarek

From: Jarek Potiuk <jarek@potiuk.com>

Subject: [ANNOUNCE] New PMC member: Pavan kumar Gopidesu

Dear Airflow Community,

The Apache Airflow Project Management Committee (PMC) has invited Pavan kumar Gopidesu to become a PMC member and we are excited to announce that he has accepted our invitation.

Pavan has been a committer for the past 2 years and has made significant contributions to the project, most notably in the CI/CD/Dev environment.
This included contributing to the Apache Software Foundation, which made him an ASF member even before being Airflow PMC member :).

Recently Pavan has been working on the AIP-99 Common Data Access Pattern + AI and this work is well underway.

He actively spread the Airflow word at the Airflow Summit-and spoke in Seattle even if he could not attend the event due to visa issues. What a dedication! Here are the talks he gave-with Amogh, Kaxil, and me.

*
https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2025/airflow-as-an-ai-agents-toolkit-unlocking-1000-integrations-with-mcp/

*
https://airflowsummit.org/sessions/2025/the-secret-to-airflow-s-evergreen-build-ci-cd-magic/

The PMC is confident that he will continue to be a strong ambassador for Airflow with his new PMC hat on.

For those unfamiliar, PMC members help manage and guide the overall direction of the project.

Please join us in congratulating Pavan - welcome aboard!

Best regards,

Jarek

messages.subject: Re: [ANNOUNCE] New PMC member: Pavan kumar Gopidesu
messages.body:
Thank you all so much for the warm wishes and congratulations. I am truly
honored to join the PMC.

My journey with the Airflow began in April 2024, starting with a POC I was
working on. That initial experience led me to dive deeper into the project
and stay involved with this incredible community.

I look forward to continuing my contributions to the project and helping
everyone. A huge thank you to all the PMC members, committers, and the
entire community for your guidance and support.

Regards,
Pavan
